reviewer_statement: Developer-scoped native R image-file export with actual bytes and overwrite, not independently certified Matplotlib Figure/pathlib/path metadata compatibility. Native and frozen Python tests authored; no exact-head executable success yet.
native_language_semantic_policy: Preserves safe no-overwrite legacy default. Strict mode writes real nonempty PDF/SVG/PNG, validates declared route and file extension, applies device DPI, supports destination overwrite, and closes native devices on success/failure.

case_evidence.description: Frozen Python save_workflow_figure source accepts explicit result/path/plot, positive dpi, close and forwards plot_kwargs; R strict source mode documents its backend restrictions.
Single output path ending png, svg or pdf; native figure device DPI integer 1..1200 and close TRUE. Python close FALSE, arbitrary matplotlib axes and broader dpi types are excluded.
Dispatches a genuine native R plot, writes a nonempty PDF/SVG/PNG output after device close, and permits reusing a destination; no placeholder figures.
Fails unsupported extension, invalid dpi, close FALSE and invalid workflow plot; closes active device on failure and cleans newly created partial destination.
Returns normalized R file path invisibly after verifying file existence and positive length; Python pathlib.Path and exact Matplotlib metadata bytes are excluded.
Figure serialization of the same explicitly chosen scientific plot; no independent fitting, uncertainty recalibration, plot guessing or data transformation.

independent_review_status: Provisional developer-scoped W4 implementation, independent full-contract certification zero; exact-head native R/Python CI not yet witnessed green.
language_specific_limits: No Matplotlib image/pixel or SVG Date=None metadata identity.
Native close=FALSE cannot flush a file while retaining a usable Matplotlib figure, so is rejected.
Python pathlib.Path and original figure object lifetime are not represented.

legacy_public_function_deduplication_rev.reason: Public plot_workflow_result/save_workflow_figure had two top-level R definitions, where later strict-source wrappers captured earlier implementations. The first implementations are now named stable .etr_workflow_legacy_plot/.etr_workflow_legacy_save helpers and the redundant capture aliases removed. The public strict-source wrappers and functional bodies are unchanged. This is a source structure fix, not new Python full-domain parity or independent review.
